example.title: Curry Creek Bridge (GDOT Bridge 157/00015/012.80N), State Route 15 over Curry Creek

brief: State-highway filled-spandrel ("solid") reinforced-concrete arch of 1926 at the edge of a small town: three segmental arches of increasing size toward the middle on wide piers, plain solid spandrel walls, a projecting deck band and a concrete balustrade of short square balusters between panelled posts, with W-beam guardrail on the approaches and route shields at the ends. Two-lane highway crossing a grassy creek bottom with scattered trees; no builder's plate.
